answer: Each agent proves a unique kernel: a ZK attestation of a secret held only in one TPM enclave, renewed each epoch and bound to the latest orchard Merkle root of challenge seeds. Proof generation takes exclusive enclave cycles. An attacker spinning N sybils must buy and power N separate TPM devices (~$50 capital + electricity each); sharing is detectable by timing. Honest agents pay once. Linear hardware cost exceeds per-identity rewards for large N, so mass forgery is unprofitable. Optional lotus bond raises the capital floor.
